newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU grain panel sets dates for summer export tender.
newsitem.headline: EU grain panel sets dates for summer export tender.

text.p: The European Union cereals management committee, which adjudicates weekly grain export tenders, is to meet once a fortnight in July and August, a European Commission official confirmed.
Meetings have been scheduled for July 3, July 17 and July 31 and on August 14 and August 28. Regular weekly meetings will resume in September.

Last week a European grain official told Reuters the grain panel would meet only once very two weeks in July and August, instead of each Thursday, as a further sign of prudence in exports. He had said at the time that 1997/98 free market export tenders would not be opened "for the time being."
The summer schedule covers the European harvest period and a gap between the old crop and new crop export campaigns.
Last year the slower schedule only applied in August.

European Commission cereals director Jose Manuel Silva said in Paris on Friday that the EU will launch 1997/98 (July/June) export tenders in the coming weeks. But exports are not expected to pick up pace until after the harvest has been gathered in. --Brussels newsroom +322 287 6830
